tools.name: clinical-trials__search
tools.description: Find studies by condition, intervention (drug/device), location, sponsor or free text, optionally filtered by status and phase. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: clinical-trials__study
tools.description: One study: title, status, phase, conditions, interventions, sponsor, enrolment, dates, eligibility basics, primary outcomes, countries, whether results are posted. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: clinical-trials__recruiting
tools.description: Studies recruiting (or about to) for a condition in a city, region or country, with the matching trial sites. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: clinical-trials__stats
tools.description: How many registered studies for a condition are recruiting, active, completed, terminated or withdrawn. A few free samples a day, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: nhs-organisations__organisation
tools.description: Name, status, address, phone/website, roles and relationships (commissioner, operator, geography) for one ODS code. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: nhs-organisations__search
tools.description: Find NHS organisations by name, postcode (or district) and role: gp, pharmacy, trust, trust-site, icb, dental, optical, care-home, hospice, or a role code. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: nhs-organisations__roles
tools.description: Every ODS role code with its name, and the friendly aliases search accepts. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.0005 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: pubmed__search
tools.description: PubMed ids matching a query (supports PubMed query syntax). A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: pubmed__summary
tools.description: Title, authors, journal, date and DOI for comma-separated PubMed ids. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: pubmed__pmc-search
tools.description: Free full-text article ids in PubMed Central. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: pubmed__clinical-trials-search
tools.description: PubMed citations that are clinical trial reports for a query. A few free samples a day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__rxcui
tools.description: Exact (normalised) match of a drug name to its RxNorm concept id(s). Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__approximate
tools.description: Ranked RxNorm candidates for a misspelled or partial drug name. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__spelling
tools.description: Correctly spelled RxNorm drug names close to the input. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__drugs
tools.description: Every clinical drug, branded drug and pack for an ingredient or brand name, grouped by RxNorm term type. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__related
tools.description: Ingredients, brand names, dose forms and clinical/branded drugs related to an RxCUI. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__properties
tools.description: Name, synonym, term type and active/obsolete status of an RxCUI. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__ndc
tools.description: National Drug Code (10 or 11 digits) to its RxNorm concept and status. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: rxnorm__ndcs
tools.description: Active National Drug Codes for an RxNorm clinical or branded drug. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__drug-adverse-events
tools.description: FAERS adverse event reports for a drug. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__drug-recalls
tools.description: Drug recall enforcement reports. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__drug-ndc
tools.description: National Drug Code directory entries. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__drugs-fda
tools.description: FDA approval history (Drugs@FDA) for an application or brand. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__device-events
tools.description: MAUDE medical device adverse event reports. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__device-recalls
tools.description: Medical device recalls. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__device-510k
tools.description: Premarket 510(k) clearances. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__food-recalls
tools.description: Food recall enforcement reports. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__food-adverse-events
tools.description: CAERS reports for foods, supplements and cosmetics. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

tools.name: openfda__drug-labels
tools.description: Structured prescribing information: indications, dosage, warnings, interactions. Free within the daily allowance, then $0.003 USDC per call via x402.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "nhs-organisations__organisation" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
